text:
mira_product: Customer asked for 7-year audit log custody under customer-controlled keys. Can we propose a Q2 pilot and a short acceptance checklist?
jacob_security: Two safe patterns: (A) export-only: monthly encrypted snapshots to customer bucket with signed manifests; (B) in-place BYOK: store encrypted logs in-system referencing customer key pointers + attestation. Export-only limits our compliance footprint.
elaine_legal: Contract bullets we need: custody statement (we never hold plaintext if BYOK), termination export window, chain-of-custody format, and who pays e-discovery. Need acceptance text to attach to SOW.
nick_eng: Quick infra notes: export-only is faster (snapshot worker + signer + delivery receipts). In-place BYOK needs per-tenant key lifecycle and attestation verification at write time. Indexing optional. Rough effort: export pilot ~3-4w 0.5 FTE; in-place ~8-10w 1.2 FTE.
omar_sre: Ops requirements: legal_hold toggle that immediately pauses TTL expiry, manifest verification steps, RTO for restores (propose 72h), and oncall playbook for missed exports.
mira_product: Minimal acceptance checklist (draft):
- tier: "audit_extended" TTL=7y
- key_mode: "export_only" or "byok_in_place" (default: export_only)
- delivery: monthly encrypted snapshot + signed manifest (SHA256)
- evidence: signed manifest + delivery receipt stored 10y
- legal_hold: immediate suspend TTL toggle with audit trail
- restore_sla: documented RTO=72h for pilot
- search: optional paid indexing add-on
- pricing: storage+egress+indexing bands (sales to propose)
jacob_security: Add: require key attestation token at enrollment and envelope encryption (customer KEK) for exports. We'll include an attestation sample in the RFC.
elaine_legal: Legal needs final acceptance text by Tue EOD to draft SOW language. If product prefers export-first we will present that as default.
mira_product: Action items:
- mira_product + jacob_security: finalize acceptance checklist PR by Tue EOD
- nick_eng: firm estimate + staging plan by next Mon
- omar_sre: runbook skeleton by next Mon
- elaine_legal: draft SOW clauses by Wed
- opsbot: created doc https://tiny.redwood/longform-audit-custody-draft
mira_product: I'll schedule a 30m customer sync next Thu 11am PT. Keep replies brief here.
